name: Superb Outcomes
source:
Bedazzle is a hero who trusts in second chances. She persuaded the timid villain Daisy Bell to change her ways. Daisy, who once dreamed of being a scientist, offered her inventions in thanks – but her loyalty is uncertain.

[From [url=https://futureformeruser.itch.io/superb-outcomes]Itch.io[/url]]
